bagPolicy.summary: Auburn’s basketball guide prohibits backpacks and bags larger than 12 × 12 × 12 inches and warns that promoters may impose additional rules for special events. Check the concert announcement for its own limits.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking for the August 2026 Ella Langley concerts included a free Stadium Deck and $50 card-only day-of parking in the Campus Safety and Athletics Complex lots. Those locations and prices were specific to those shows; consult the next concert’s event page.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: For the August 2026 Ella Langley concerts, rideshare pickup and drop-off were assigned to bus stops on War Eagle Way north of the arena and Heisman Drive east of Jordan-Hare Stadium. The location may change for another show.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The arena basketball guide lists multiple stands and says concessions and merchandise transactions are cashless, using credit or debit cards and Tiger Cards.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Elevators inside Neville Arena are available to guests with disabilities or special needs; accessible parking for basketball is at Wire Road and Extension Loop.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The arena basketball guide says EMS may authorize a medical re-entry wristband at its discretion. It does not publish a general concert re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The August 2026 concert guide states that tickets for those shows were digital and guests could download them to a mobile wallet. It gives no will-call pickup procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The August 2026 Ella Langley concert guide set doors at 6 p.m. for a 7:10 p.m. first performance. Door times for other concerts depend on their event guidance.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
